description: Source code for UE creation procedure in a 5G network DU (Distributed Unit), including context creation, resource setup, RLC/SDU configuration, and communication with MAC and F1AP layers.

classes.name: ue_creation_procedure
classes.description: Handles the process of creating a UE in the DU, including context creation, resource setup, and communication with MAC and F1 layers.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine executing the UE creation sequence.

methods.name: create_du_ue_context
methods.description: Creates and adds a new DU UE context based on request parameters.

methods.name: clear_ue
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the UE context and related resources.

methods.name: setup_du_ue_resources
methods.description: Sets up PCell and SRB resources for the UE.

methods.name: create_rlc_srbs
methods.description: Creates RLC entities for SRB0 and SRB1.

methods.name: create_mac_ue
methods.description: Sends request to MAC layer to create UE context.

methods.name: connect_layer_bearers
methods.description: Connects bearers between F1AP, RLC, and MAC layers.
